fields.Name: Sales User
fields.Description: Works deals. May delete an open, never-closed deal they own (MJ.BizApps.Sales.Deal.DeleteOwn).

fields.Name: Sales Admin
fields.Description: Administers deals. May delete any open, never-closed deal (MJ.BizApps.Sales.Deal.Delete).

fields.Name: Sales Offboarding
fields.Description: Held by supervisors who hand a departed person's sales items to a successor. Grants only read and update on the records the offboarding reassign moves for them (deals, deal team members, pipelines), plus create and delete on deal team members for the owner swap. Holding it does not authorize a move: the reassign still requires the leaver's supervisor or a Sales Admin, and account and contact moves stay with Sales Admins. Admins assign it.
